event.name: Formula 1 Pirelli British Grand Prix 2026
event.format: Alternative (sprint weekend): FP1, Sprint Qualifying, Sprint, Qualifying, Race

lap_record.note: Race lap record as listed on formula1.com. The 2026 race fastest lap (ANT 1:31.777) did not beat it; the 2026 pole (1:28.111) is a qualifying time and does not count as a lap record.

turns.note: Corner numbers T1-T18 appear on the FIA circuit map.

split_points_from_control_line_km.note: Cumulative sums of the published sector lengths; the map gives lengths, not lap-distance positions. 1.823+2.464+1.604 = 5.891 = centreline length.

track_limits_note.quote: Each time a driver fails to respect track limits at turn 18, will result in that lap time and the immediately following lap time being invalidated by the Stewards.

active_aero_straight_mode.rule: 2026 has no DRS. Driver Adjustable Bodywork (front wing flaps + rear wing flap) switches between Corner Mode and Straight Mode inside FIA Activation Zones (Sporting Regulations B7.1; Technical C3.10.10 and C3.11.6). Full activation = front and rear in Straight Mode; in Low Grip Conditions only partial activation (front wing only) in the Low Grip Activation Zones (B7.1.1 d, B7.1.2 b).

zones.note: Map prints n/a for low grip: no low-grip activation in this zone.

zones.straight: T14 to T15 (the straight with the speed trap, 140m before T15)

zone_end.note: The map gives only activation points. Where Straight Mode must end (deactivation) is not printed on the map; not found in the event documents read.

active_aero_straight_mode.straight_descriptions_note: The `straight` field is read off the map drawing (which turn numbers bound each zone), not printed text.

overtake_mode.detection: Exit of T17 (map); lap distance 5560 m (TBC) in the PU information document
overtake_mode.rule_ref: Sporting Regulations B7.2.2-B7.2.3; Technical C5.2.8 ii

energy_limits.note: Main overtaking zones use the Base-Standard / Base-Overtake ERS-K power curves; the Alt 1 curve applies in the listed sectors in Sprint and Race (document graphic; curve values are only drawn, not tabulated).

tyres.compound_note: The preview lists C1 (white W), C2 (yellow Y), C3 (red R); hard/medium/soft names follow the colour codes.

wind_direction.note: Mostly between W and S, near W. Only a chart is published; no numeric value, so read approximately from the plot (N/W/S/E axis).

qualifying.note: best_s is the driver's fastest lap across Q1-Q3 (it is not always the lap that set the grid order, e.g. LAW 1:29.300 in Q1, HUL 1:29.539 in Q1). Speed trap = FIA speed trap 140m before T15.

starting_grid.note: Differs from qualifying order: GAS 12th -> 15th (3-place grid penalty, impeding car 18), STR 21st -> 22nd (PU elements changed).

penalties: Car 12 (ANT) 5 s time penalty, track limits (Stewards doc 77)
Car 55 (SAI) 1 penalty lap, overtaking the Safety Car (Stewards doc 83)
Car 44 (HAM) 5 s time penalty, false start (served)
Car 18 (STR) three 5 s penalties, track limits (served)
neutralisations: Safety Car deployed 16:18; in this lap 16:27; deployed again 16:27; in this lap 16:29; chequered flag 16:31
race.fastest_lap_no_note: formula1.com and the FIA classification give different lap numbers for the fastest lap of 9 cars (PIA, BEA, OCO, PER, BOT, ALO, STR, ALB, HUL: FIA 1-3 laps lower). These are mostly cars lapped during the race; FIA appears to count the car's own laps, formula1.com possibly the leader's lap. Times agree exactly. Not resolved.
race.note: Finish came straight after a late Safety Car period, so the gaps (top 16 within 8.2 s) are compressed. Race speed traps are higher than qualifying ones (tow and energy deployment differ).

redbull.change: Rear wheel bodywork winglets (number of cascade elements changed)

ferrari.change: Increased cooling inlet and outlet sections, updated lower deflector, re-optimized rearward winglet cluster

williams.change: New front wing geometry with updated profiles and endplate surfaces

haas.change: Rear Wing Endplate with external protrusions

upgrades.note: Empty list = team submitted no updates for this event (Mercedes, Aston Martin, Audi, Alpine, Cadillac).
